themes.title: Local and Regional Dynamics in Right-Wing Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements continue to demonstrate influence and strategy at sub-national levels. In Norway, local populations defy bureaucratic directives to protect skilled trades, while in the US, the MAGA movement consolidates power through state and local judicial appointments and uses local law enforcement for national policy implementation.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The MAGA movement utilizes local and state-level courts for electoral goals and influences local law enforcement in immigration crackdowns, demonstrating a decentralized yet coordinated strategy, including engagement with local leaders on urban issues.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local communities actively resist regional administrative decisions to preserve building trades, showcasing popular defiance against top-down bureaucracy and local prioritization in policy debates.
